{{- /*
llms.txt: concise AI site index (https://llmstxt.org/).

Override of the Hextra theme template (layouts/llms.txt) that adds an
agent-guidance preamble: how to retrieve a single page as markdown and where
to find the full corpus. The section tree that follows is the theme's.

Pages/sections can opt out with "llms: false" front matter.
*/ -}}
# {{ .Site.Title }}

> {{ site.Params.description | default "" }}

How to use these docs as an AI agent:
- Fetch a single page as raw markdown by appending ".md" to its URL
  (for example /docs/install.md).
- Fetch this index (concise, links + summaries) at /llms.txt.
- Fetch the entire corpus in one file at /llms-full.txt (large; may exceed
  a context window - prefer the .md pages for targeted retrieval).
- Prefer the linked page for exact, current details over summaries here.

{{ range where site.Sections "Params.llms" "ne" false }}
{{- template "llms-section-tree" dict "context" . "level" 2 }}
{{ end }}

{{- $rootPages := where (where site.RegularPages "Section" "") "Params.llms" "ne" false }}
{{- if $rootPages }}
## Root Pages
{{- range $rootPages }}
- [{{ .Title }}]({{ .Permalink }}): {{ .Summary | plainify | truncate 100 | strings.TrimSpace }}{{ if .Date }} - Published {{ .Date.Format "2006-01-02" }}{{ end }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

---
Generated on {{ now.Format "2006-01-02 15:04:05 UTC" }}
Site: {{ .Site.BaseURL }}

{{- define "llms-section-tree" -}}
{{- $context := .context -}}
{{- $level := .level | default 2 -}}
{{- $headerHashes := strings.Repeat $level "#" -}}
{{- "\n" -}}
{{ $headerHashes }} {{ $context.Title }}

{{- range where $context.RegularPages "Params.llms" "ne" false }}
- [{{ .Title }}]({{ .Permalink }}): {{ .Summary | plainify | truncate 100 | strings.TrimSpace }}{{ if .Date }} - Published {{ .Date.Format "2006-01-02" }}{{ end }}
{{- end }}

{{- range where $context.Sections "Params.llms" "ne" false }}
{{ template "llms-section-tree" dict "context" . "level" (add $level 1) }}
{{- end }}
{{- end -}}
